svg.title: TOOLS-GITHUB-ACTIONS-MONITOR-ANDROID architecture
svg.desc: The Android app reads the read API v1 of GitHub Actions Monitor with a bearer token kept in the Android Keystore, shows the summary, alerts, repositories and action proposals, lets a person approve or reject a proposal, opens ghamon links, and has critical-only push notifications that are off by default behind a null push service.
